Chapter 609: Chapter 35 Xilan: Where are the Elders? (Subscribe Please)_2

“The escape methods of the Void Evolution Path are indeed as legendary as they say,” Hunyi said with a slightly stern expression, while also speeding up the process of completely occupying the Spatial Layers.

The Void Evolution Path was the path of evolution cultivated by Xilan, and it was also one of the Nine Great Supreme Evolution Paths currently mastered by Human Civilization.

The ultimate being of this evolution path was the Void God Ultimate Being, who was one of the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization.

In terms of combat power and killing ability, the Void God Supreme Being might not match the Xia Qin Supreme Being or the Ancient Power Supreme Being, but in terms of control over the void, they were the strongest among the nine Supreme Beings.

Within Human Civilization, the most practiced evolution paths were those of the nine Supreme Beings.

Although these Nine Great Supreme Evolution Paths all had ultimate beings, the vast majority of human Evolvers neither had the desire nor the ability to challenge the ultimate level.

...

In their eyes, the Supreme Evolution Path was mature, nearly perfect, and if one had the qualifications to cultivate it, who would choose any other evolution path?

Xilan had a talent for the spatial domain, and with her special body with spatial attributes, she could activate many of the escape techniques from the Void Evolution Path, which is how she had managed to persist so far under Hunyi’s persecution.

“Almost there, almost there,” Hunyi thought, retracting his thoughts. No matter how exquisite the Void Evolution Path was, it still required space to operate, and now, after two or three years, with him continuously taking over the Spatial Layers, Xilan was close to being trapped to death by him.

…

The relentless pursuit by Hunyi, the strongest Ninth Rank being of the Tianyu Clan, also caught the attention of other Ninth Rank beings in the vicinity.

“Is that the Tianyu Clan’s Hunyi? The one called the first Ninth Rank of this era of the Tianyu Clan? Who is he chasing?”

“You don’t know? The one being chased is Xilan, the Ninth Rank Evolver from Human Civilization. But what Hunyi is after is not Xilan, but the Galaxy Master who is traveling with her.”

“The Galaxy Master? The human peerless genius who recently caused the Tianyu Clan to lose face on the battlefield? The youngest Ninth Rank in the history of Human Civilization?”

“So it seems.”

…

Various Ninth Rank beings watched from afar, Hunyi’s pursuit was not being concealed at all, and the bursting spatial fluctuations could be easily detected.

“The Galaxy Master is being chased?”

Some of the Ninth Rank Different Species with relatively good relations with Human Civilization were tempted, knowing that if they could save the Galaxy Master now, they would surely gain the favor of this peerless genius of human civilization.

Unfortunately though,

it was Hunyi who was chasing the Galaxy Master, and even though some Ninth Rank Different Species wanted to please Lin Yuan and Human Civilization, they didn’t have the power to hold Hunyi back.

In the Cosmic Starry Skies, Human Civilization was one of the few Peak Clans, an absolute behemoth, with enemies as well as follower clans.

Apart from the big Alliance established by Human Civilization itself, there were still many clans who did not want to offend Human Civilization and even sought friendship with it.

“Hahaha, Hunyi has been chasing Xilan for over two years now, and the Galaxy Master must be hiding in Xilan’s Inner World. They say Xilan cultivates the Void Evolution Path… tsk, truly as legendary as they say.”

“Being pursued for more than two years, the Galaxy Master is in such a dire state!”

“It’s also unclear what the Galaxy Master is holding on for. Xilan must have used some Secret Technique that affects the true body of the main being, with such a cost, could it be that a special Ninth Rank from Human Civilization is coming to their rescue?”

“I haven’t heard of any nearby human Ninth Rank who can come close to Hunyi.”

…

The many Ninth Rank Different Species, separated by different Spatial Layers, conversed with keen interest. Regardless of whether it was the one being pursued or the pursuer, both were extremely famous.

They were also happy to watch the drama unfold.

Needless to say, Hunyi’s renown had spread throughout the Ninth Rank circle, and the Galaxy Master, although only recently advancing to Ninth Rank, had garnered considerable attention due to the revealed talent as well as the halo of Human Civilization.

…

On the other side of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,

a human Evolver clad in a purple robe was continuously shuttling through the layers of space.

His speed was tremendous, and each transition affected more than forty million Spatial Layers.

This purple-robed Evolver, named Duoke, had established thirty-nine million Spatial Layers and was the strongest Ninth Rank being of this era in Human Civilization.

“Just hold on a little longer. Once I get there, I will ensure that Hunyi pays the price!”

The location Duoke was heading towards was where Hunyi was.

As the strongest Ninth Rank of one of the great peak clans, Duoke often clashed with Hunyi. The spatial layers created by the former were more numerous than those of the latter, giving him a natural advantage in combat.

More than two years ago, when he learned that Hunyi was pursuing the Galaxy Master, he rushed over as quickly as possible.

Normally, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm suppresses all deliberate spatial movements, forcing even the strongest beings to fly slowly. When Duoke received the message, he was a great distance from Hunyi’s location.

It was almost impossible to arrive within three years.

But even so, Duoke did not hesitate to come.

“Hunyi, if you dare to kill this incarnation of the Galaxy Master, within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, your Tianyu Clan’s Ninth Rank should also stop living,” Duoke thought to himself.

Usually, special Ninth Rank beings like them wouldn’t deliberately pursue and kill other Ninth Rank alien races after entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Because it’s too time-consuming. The Xuanhuang Secret Realm isn’t like the outside world; one can only fly slowly, and it’s only open for a hundred years.

Pursuing other Ninth Rank alien races… Would they really forsake the many opportunities within the secret realm?

But Hunyi dared to actively pursue the peerless genius of human civilization. This precedent cannot be set. Duoke would rather give up searching for opportunities within the secret realm than not fight back.

…

Deep within the heavy spatial layers.

The Maduo Traveler was also watching the chase from afar.

Hunyi had been pursuing Xilan and the Galaxy Master for over two years. After receiving the news, the Maduo Traveler also rushed over.

“The Galaxy Master is really unlucky,” thought the Maduo Traveler to himself, having already warned the Galaxy Master, who would surely try to avoid Hunyi as much as possible.

The environment of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is unique; even if Hunyi received the location of the Galaxy Master one moment, by the time he arrived the next, the Galaxy Master would likely have already disappeared.

Unless the two happened to meet face to face.

“It’s just… The Ancient God Ancestor really values the Galaxy Master, going so far as to let me use that trump card to block Hunyi and save the Galaxy Master…”

The Maduo Traveler shook his head slightly.

As the most outstanding progeny of the Ancient God Ancestor, the Maduo Traveler was deeply cherished by him. Upon entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm this time, he was even bestowed a lifesaving trump card.

Once this trump card is activated, even a special Ninth Rank capable of creating fifty million or eighty million spatial layers would be trapped for a short while.

“The Ancestor said not to use the trump card to directly save the Galaxy Master, but to act only when the Galaxy Master is in the most critical moment, precisely when he is about to be captured by Hunyi. Only then can we gain the Galaxy Master’s utmost gratitude.”

Remembering the instructions of the Ancient God Ancestor, the Maduo Traveler felt they made sense.

“It’s almost time,” observed the Maduo Traveler for a while longer. Noting that Xilan’s struggle to escape was slowing down, his expression immediately became serious, waiting for the critical moment to activate the lifesaving trump card.

…

Within the inner world of Xilan.

Lin Yuan quietly opened his eyes.

“I’m back,” said Lin Yuan, his gaze deep as the millennia spent in the World of Gods seemed like fleeting illusions flashing by.

Whoosh.

Sensing Lin Yuan’s movement, Xilan immediately projected her consciousness incarnation and appeared not far away.

“Brother Xilan,” Lin Yuan said with a smile on his face, knowing that Xilan’s perseverance was crucial for the perfect completion of this traversal.

Otherwise, Lin Yuan would have had to terminate the traversal prematurely or give up the Primordial Spirit within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Whichever option, it would be a significant loss.

“Galaxy Master,” Xilan said with a faltering breath, but still forcibly perked up.

After a brief conversation, Xilan cautiously asked, “Galaxy Master, has your elder come yet?”

“Elder?” Lin Yuan glanced at Xilan.
